sources.details: T_plain(N)=pN; T_compiled(N)=S+cN; equality requires N=S/(p-c) for p>c. S=2,p=.01,c=.006 gives N=500; S=4 gives N=1000. If S>0 and p-c<=0, T_compiled-T_plain=S+(c-p)N remains positive for nonnegative N. Exact Decimal CPU checks saved.
